purpose: The atomic, gated LINE the ATELIER design-system studio walks. Mirrors the SOCC entity lifecycle. Each frontier = one accepted artifact. Statuses are HONEST: the crew already shipped the renderers + core components + cabinet adoption before genesis, so those frontiers are marked DONE; the rest stay LOCKED until accepted.

gate_legend.SCI: Scientific — decisions evidence-based (WCAG numbers, render proofs), explicit pass/fail
gate_legend.HER: Hermes — it actually renders/works (python runs, HTML opens, tokens resolve)
gate_legend.COD: Codex — conforms to canon law (re-skinned, naming, surface law, truth_boundary present)
gate_legend.GRD: Guardian — adversarial a11y + coherence critique before ACCEPT

phases.title: ATELIER GENESIS
phases.goal: Formalise the studio that already gelled (no new pixels).

frontiers.produces: ATELIER_LINE_V1 (this LINE) + GATES + state + genesis proof

phases.title: RENDER ENGINE (two canons, one pattern)
phases.goal: One renderer per canon; surfaces compose, never re-style.

frontiers.produces: anna_canon_html.py — product D3 renderer (twin of socc_canon_html)
reuse socc_canon_html.py for operator surfaces (no duplication)

phases.title: COMPONENT LIBRARY
phases.goal: The atom/molecule set in both canons, token-bound.

phases.title: LIVING STYLEGUIDE
phases.goal: One gallery that shows the whole system, each canon in its own skin.

phases.title: PATTERNS / TEMPLATES
phases.goal: Composable templates for the real surfaces.

frontiers.produces: owner cabinet pattern (refactored onto the system)
landing hero (B2B) pattern -> SYSTEM/BRAND_FORGE/anna_landing.py + runtime/ANNA_LANDING_V1.html (hero/features/steps/faq/lead_form/cta_band added to renderer)

phases.title: MOTION + ACCESSIBILITY
phases.goal: Motion system + a measured WCAG pass across both canons.

phases.title: ADOPTION
phases.goal: Every SOCC/ANNA surface renders through the system.

frontiers.produces: migrate remaining surfaces (landing, touchpoints, dashboards) onto the renderers

phases.title: SEAL
phases.goal: Canonize the design system; the studio stays a reusable organ.

frontiers.produces: SEAL (verify full chain, canonize & accept -> design system is law; ATELIER reusable)

truth_boundary: LINE declaration. Lists the gated frontier sequence. Statuses are honest: renderers + core components + cabinet adoption are genuinely DONE (built & rendered by this line); the styleguide is IN_REVIEW (built, awaiting creator look); motion/a11y/landing/seal are LOCKED. No frontier past the current one is executed until accepted. Producing this LINE makes no external claim.
